pins.definition: Information that you keep hidden from others.
A piece of information that is kept hidden from other people.
Something kept hidden from others, or the key to achieving something.

situation: A woman leans across a wooden table by candlelight, whispering something behind her hand so a third person across the room cannot hear.
subject: information kept hidden
brief: A woman in a dimly lit tavern leans forward, cupping her hand tightly over the ear of a man sitting beside her to whisper out of earshot, while a second man sits nearby staring intently into his drink, excluded.
prompt: A woman in a dimly lit tavern leans forward, cupping her hand tightly over the ear of a man sitting beside her to whisper out of earshot, while a second man sits nearby staring intently into his drink, excluded. a baroque painting in the manner of Caravaggio, one hard light source out of deep black, sculpted flesh and fabric, theatrical gesture. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
